svg.aria-label: A continuous ink drawing for Rwanda: a ledger page drawn in plain rule lines fills the right of the sheet, two narrow columns side by side under a single header rule, each column holding a stack of horizontal entry marks. The left column's stack and the right column's stack stand at almost exactly the same height, and a fine dashed level line is drawn across from one to the other to show it. Away to the left, a long low row of small upright tally strokes runs along the foot of the page, far more numerous than the entries in either column, one of them traced in warm kiln-orange. Nothing is written in words anywhere.
svg.title: The Still · Rwanda — two columns that stand level, and the tally that did not move them
svg.desc: Paper-cream ground, pure line, no fills — tone carried by stroke weight and opacity alone. A ledger occupies the right of the page: one header rule, a single vertical divider, and two columns of horizontal entry marks whose stacks reach almost the same height, with a dashed level line drawn between their tops. A long low row of 34 upright tally strokes runs along the foot of the page to the left, one of them in kiln orange. No words, no numerals, no figures.
